mapper.select: SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master ORDER BY review_start_date desc
SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}
SELECT eval_seq, company_code, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight FROM tb_eval_item WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}

SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master
AND review_master_name LIKE '%' || #{reviewMasterName} || '%'
AND review_start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(#{reviewStartDate}) AND TRUNC(#{reviewEndDate})
AND use_yn IN
#{yn}
ORDER BY review_start_date desc
